excluded_families.phys_osc: All 44 tasks have historical PCPI cross-task artifacts.

primary_metric.name: decision_readiness_rate
primary_metric.task_seed_indicator: one iff the frozen bank is viable and its certified expected Bayes zero-one decision-risk-reduction lower bound exceeds the action-family numerical resolution; zero for unresolved ranks, abstentions, timeouts, provider failures, invalid outputs, or any protocol failure
primary_metric.task_score: arithmetic mean of the three fixed-seed indicators
primary_metric.estimand: unweighted arithmetic mean of task scores over every registered task
primary_metric.paired_effect: full_scientist_v6 task score minus no_llm_v6 task score
primary_metric.success_rule: paired mean DRR improvement at least 0.10 and the lower endpoint of the 95 percent paired task-bootstrap interval is strictly greater than zero

claim_boundary: This protocol freezes task selection, the sole primary metric, denominator, budgets, failures and statistical decision before benchmark execution. It does not authorize LLM calls, task-array loading, test or OOD access, efficacy claims, or superiority claims.
